verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a public API/SDK that can create and update agents (gumloop-docs-24, gumloop-docs-15) and that agents can be triggered/activated via schedules, app triggers, or webhooks (gumloop-docs-3, gumloop-docs-35), with Python/JS SDKs (gumloop-docs-17, gumloop-docs-29). However there's no explicit 'activate' endpoint or workflow-lifecycle example showing an agent programmatically both creating and then turning on/deploying a workflow end-to-end, and no OpenAPI spec is reachable (gumloop-probe-2) to verify full CRUD/activation coverage. missing for 10: a documented 'activate'/enable endpoint or explicit end-to-end example of create+update+activate via API, reachable OpenAPI/schema confirming full lifecycle coverage, independent/hands-on confirmation.
